id: validation-Correct MCP Tool Name and Parameters-case-1

pointer.content:
Test Case 1: Verify Tool Name Has Correct Prefix

Input:
- File: repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/session/template-metrics-client.ts
- Check: Tool name in callMCPTool invocation

Expected Output:
- Tool name: 'metabob_post_activity_result'
- Has prefix: true
- Format: metabob_* naming convention

Validation:
- Parse file for callMCPTool invocation
- Extract tool name from first argument
- Verify it starts with 'metabob_'
- Verify exact name is 'metabob_post_activity_result'

PASS Criteria:
- Tool name exactly matches 'metabob_post_activity_result'
- Name includes 'metabob_' prefix

FAIL Criteria:
- Tool name is 'post_activity_result' (missing prefix)
- Tool name has any other value
- Tool name cannot be found in file
